m1.caption: The laundry chute dare — age 7
m1.content: A small girl peering nervously into an open laundry chute door in a 1990s hallway while her best friend gestures grandly for her to climb in.

m2.caption: The bathtub potion incident — age 6
m2.content: Two small girls in pajamas at a bathroom sink, one gleefully pouring a rainbow of bottles into the swirling water with mad-scientist delight.

m3.caption: Hide and seek, abandoned — age 8
m3.content: A small girl peeking out of a dark hallway closet, far down the hall a babysitter and a boy calmly playing cards at the kitchen table.
